document: HES Trade Agent Promotion Contract v1 — G5 Pre-Registration Amendment v1
purpose: Define an executable G5 Fold/LOFO acceptance rule prospectively, without changing the frozen 800/400/400 eight-fold evaluation protocol. This amendment must not be used to reclassify already-observed G5 evidence.

effective_scope.applies_to: A newly frozen G5 evaluation performed after this amendment is merged and validated.

pre_registered_g5_criterion.principle: A single fold must not be able to dominate the evidence such that removing that fold reverses the direction of the aggregate result.

checks.rule: The full locked evaluation population must have positive aggregate gross return.
For every eligible fold, removing that entire fold must leave the aggregate gross return positive.
The fold contributing the largest absolute share of aggregate gross return must contribute less than 50% of total absolute gross-return magnitude.

pre_registered_g5_criterion.decision_rule: G5 PASS requires all three checks to PASS. Otherwise G5 remains BLOCKED.
pre_registered_g5_criterion.fold_eligibility: All eight protocol folds are in scope; a fold with zero observations is a protocol/data-integrity failure and cannot be silently skipped.
pre_registered_g5_criterion.no_statistical_claim: Passing G5 does not prove independence, predictive validity, causality, or market generalization.

invariants: No threshold tuning after observing outcomes.
No retroactive reclassification of current G5 evidence.
